name: World Digital Book
description:
World Digital Book is a digital reading platform designed to make discovering and reading books simple and convenient. Explore a collection of digital books, open your favourite books, and enjoy a smooth reading experience with easy navigation between pages.

Features:

- Explore and discover digital books.
- Read books directly in the app.
- Easy next-page and previous-page navigation.
- Simple and user-friendly interface.
- Access your digital library conveniently.

Created and directed by Mr. Nirmit Pohane.

Welcome to World Digital Book – Your Digital Library!
